title: Finite-Tor constructibility of the shifted finite root line
statement:
Fix the finite coefficient datum P of [def-pur-conventions], with ell different from the characteristic and positive coefficient level n. For every k-scheme T, the ordinary finite root line mu_(ell^n) tensor_(Z/ell^n) A_(E,n), shifted by two, pulled from the small etale site to the small pro-etale site and transported through the specified intrinsic realization [def-pur-finite-reduction-root-charts], is finite-Tor constructible [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]. No finite-type, separatedness or ramification-divisibility hypothesis on T or n is imposed. The empty scheme is included.

theorem finiteReductionLineInput_constructible (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    (T : Scheme.{u}) [T.Over (Spec (.of P.field.k))] :
    finiteTorConstructible P.coefficients.l P.extension P.level P.level_pos T
      ((Scheme.sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence T P.Ring).functor.obj
        ((ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) T).mapDerivedCategory.obj
          ((Etale.ordinaryFiniteLine P.Coefficient P.diagonalExponent
            P.diagonalExponent_annihilates T)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧)))

proof.text: Since ell differs from the field characteristic, ell^n is nonzero. Choose a primitive ell^n-th root in the algebraically closed base field. The specified root chart identifies the displayed input with the degree-two shift of the coefficient unit.

The constant coefficient module is an invertible rank-one module. Its finite locally free line models give constructibility, and the single-complex support theorem gives bounded constructible cohomology in degree zero.

The degree-zero single complex of this module is a bounded flat model: in degree zero its tensor is the unit tensor, and all other terms are zero. The flat-model characterization supplies Tor interval [0,0]. The specified unit realization isomorphism transfers finite-Tor constructibility to the coefficient unit.
Use the triangulated and replete finite-Tor constructible subcategory to shift by two and then transfer along the root chart. This works without alteration for level one and the empty scheme.
